title: NotificationRetryRequestedV1
description:
Queue-only durable-retry job payload (spec 10 FM#6, T5a).

Lifecycle: emitted by NotificationRetryScheduler into scheduled_jobs (JobType='notification.retry.requested.v1', DestinationQueue='notification.commands') → published by ScheduledJobPollerHostedService after next_eligible_at → consumed by RetryNotificationCommandHandler, which re-drives the FailedTransient notification row through the same delivery state machine as SendNotificationCommandHandler.

Carries only the minimal identity triple (notification_id, tenant_id, operation_id) — the consumer reloads the full Notification row from the DB by (tenant_id, notification_id). This ensures retries always operate on the latest persisted state (version, attempt_count, next_eligible_at) rather than a stale snapshot in the job payload.

message_type.description: Explicit schema discriminator; always 'notification.retry.requested.v1' for this contract.

notification_id.description: The deterministic notification identity derived by the original SendNotification consumer (H(tenant, operation, event_type, recipient, template_version, material_revision)). Stable across all retries; used as the primary lookup key by RetryNotificationCommandHandler.

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope. Consumer-side writes must be scoped to this tenant. Redundant with the outer JobEnvelope tenant_id but carried inline so the job payload is self-describing when inspected in isolation.

operation_id.description: Stable operation identifier. Null only for non-operation notifications (same nullability as the original trigger). Carried for observability and audit correlation; the retry consumer uses notification_id as the primary key.
